role: A post-open, zero-new-operator-call identifiability audit of one fixed detector-plane scalar-potential gradient projector on sealed v261 Case 19 frame-zero arrays. It is not an initializer, reconstruction, repair, predictor, prospective external gate, or resource result.
scientific_question: Can an exact curl-free detector-integrability projector create a distinct deployment-visible residual direction under the current noise-free linear straight-ray forward, or is it either an identity on both y and A x14 (hence also on r14 by linearity) or not an invariant of this forward?

values_not_computed_before_freeze: detector-gradient projection defects of y, A x14, or r14
formal eigensolve versus independent SVD projector differences

frozen_arrays.independent_source: separately sealed v261 independent_observations.npy and independent_residuals.npy
frozen_arrays.prediction_definition: A x14 is reconstructed exactly as sealed observation y minus sealed raw K14 residual r14.

unique_primary_projector.name: fixed_detector_scalar_potential_gradient_range_projector
unique_primary_projector.scalar_domain: one independent 16x16 scalar potential per camera
unique_primary_projector.potential_boundary: No periodic wrap; the stated one-sided stencils define both edges.
unique_primary_projector.formal_solver: Build G, eigendecompose symmetric G^T G, discard only eigenvalues <=1e-12 times the largest eigenvalue, form an orthonormal basis G V Lambda^(-1/2), then P=Q Q^T.
unique_primary_projector.independent_solver: Build G entry by entry, use full thin SVD, retain singular values whose squares exceed 1e-12 times the largest squared singular value, then P=U U^T. It must not import the formal core or runner.
unique_primary_projector.camera_application: Apply the same fixed P independently to every active camera; no camera identity, rig label, truth, time, score, fit, threshold selection, or fallback is used.

no_go_audit.primary_defect: For each rig-camera source z, ||z-Pz||_2 divided by the norm of that camera's observation y. A common denominator preserves the linear triangle bound.
no_go_audit.energy_closure: absolute difference between ||z||^2 and ||Pz||^2+||(I-P)z||^2, divided by ||z||^2
no_go_audit.derived_bound: If both y and A x14 have primary defects <=1e-8, linearity gives the residual primary defect <=2e-8 apart from separately bounded numerical closure.

decision_order: Any parent identity, source, shape, finite, projector-rank, projector-algebra, reconstruction, linearity, energy, camera-permutation, no-go-bound, formal-independent numeric, summary, branch, or seal failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_DETECTOR_INTEGRABILITY_NO_GO_V262.

If every y and A x14 camera block is invariant within 1e-8, require every r14 block to satisfy the frozen 2e-8 derived bound and conclude FAIL_CASE19_DETECTOR_INTEGRABILITY_PROJECTOR_IDENTITY_NO_HEADROOM_V262: an exact linear invariant cannot create a distinct residual direction.

Otherwise conclude FAIL_CASE19_DETECTOR_INTEGRABILITY_PROJECTOR_NOT_FORWARD_INVARIANT_V262: the fixed curl-free projector changes at least one sealed y or A x14 block and therefore is not an exact physical constraint of the current discrete forward.
Both valid branches close only this fixed detector scalar-potential gradient projector. Neither branch proves that all local, nonlinear, noise-aware, or real-BOST mechanisms are impossible.
stop_rule: Do not construct a projected-residual candidate, call A or A^T, score truth, tune stencils/floors/tolerances, add camera weights/frequency blocks, run the 429-cell sequence, train a model, rent a GPU, run wall/RSS, or open another BLASTNet condition from v262. A later mechanism must be physically different and frozen separately before results.
